derived_features.profitability_percentile: Percentile rank of net profit across all candidate crops for this farm scenario, from 0 to 100
derived_features.soil_compatibility_score: 100 if soil type is in candidate crop preferred soils, otherwise 58
derived_features.season_compatibility_score: 100 for the crop's primary preferred season; 78 for a secondary season; 12 when not a preferred season
derived_features.rotation_compatibility_score: 76 for None/Fallow; 22 if previous crop equals candidate; 91 if previous crop is a legume and candidate is not; 84 if candidate is a legume; otherwise 72

feature_notes.soil_n_mg_kg: Synthetic numeric nitrogen proxy; measurement method/unit should be aligned with real soil-test data before deployment.
feature_notes.soil_p_mg_kg: Synthetic numeric phosphorus proxy; measurement method/unit should be aligned with real soil-test data before deployment.
feature_notes.soil_k_mg_kg: Synthetic numeric potassium proxy; measurement method/unit should be aligned with real soil-test data before deployment.
feature_notes.forecast_rainfall_mm: Synthetic expected seasonal rainfall in millimetres for demonstration only.
feature_notes.water_available_mm: Approximate synthetic seasonal water available to the plot, in mm.
feature_notes.market_price_inr_per_quintal: Synthetic market-price assumption; replace with dated local mandi/e-NAM data.

data_caution: All training labels and crop profiles are synthetic assumptions. Score is not a scientifically validated agronomic recommendation.
